title: I'm making a mystery visual novel with generative AI. Here's the opening for Neural Inside.
author: Welfero
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m developing Neural Inside, a mystery visual novel set in near-future South Korea, using generative AI throughout development.



Players investigate locations, gather evidence, interview characters, and test their deductions to uncover the truth.



For this opening, I worked shot by shot from a storyboard, using the game’s character artwork and backgrounds as visual references. I then animated selected shots and assembled the sequence.



A recurring challenge was keeping faces, clothing, and locations consistent between shots. That meant revisiting individual images and comparing them against the references. Repeated image edits could also degrade the details, so some revisions needed a fresh start from the original references.



I’d love some feedback on the opening: does the visual style feel consistent across cuts, and is there a moment where the pacing loses you?



If you’ve worked on similar sequences, I’d also be interested in how you handled continuity between generated shots.

comments.author: sunnystormy64
comments.body: The music needs work. If you're generating the music, I'd refine the prompt and get a good sample-set that covers the emotional range you need.

replies.author: Welfero
replies.body: I think I'll change the music a bit. Since I'm developing this on my own, my budget isn't exactly generous. I'll let you know if I need any help. Thanks.

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body: Looks good, i don't like the flashing lights.

replies.author: Welfero
replies.body: Looking at it again, the flashlight effect is a bit too strong. I'll fix it. Thanks for the feedback.

comments.author: Acceptable-meme4223
comments.body: stop inpainting, layered edits just blur details .y noir piece ruined itself after three touch up passes, save a clean character base in mage space to anchor fresh seeds, then run your animation passes off that crisp original frame instead of an over edited generation

replies.author: Welfero
replies.body:
Thanks for the advice.

There was a master sprite, but I think I missed it along the way. Now that you’ve pointed it out, I can see it too. I’ll take another look at the characters in the video and make the necessary corrections.
